shellCommands.command:
d=/workspace; while :; do
  grep -Hm1 '^description:' "$d"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
  [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ] && break
  d=$(dirname "$d")
done

ls /workspace/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules present" || echo "missing"; which chromium-cli 2>&1; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.267/32e7cdf96abd69906d62def6cc7dc791/run/examples/ 2>&1

lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &
disown
timeout 40 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && echo READY || (echo FAILED; cat /tmp/nextdev.log)
npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1; npm ls -g playwright 2>&1; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*playwright*" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20

curl -s -w "\n---TIMING--- TTFB:%{time_starttransfer}s TOTAL:%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/product.html
echo "--- first 2000 bytes (initial shell) ---"
head -c 3000 /tmp/product.html
echo
echo "--- grep for key markers ---"
grep -o "Premium Widget" /tmp/product.html | head -1
grep -o "Checking availability[^<]*" /tmp/product.html | head -1
grep -o "in stock" /tmp/product.html | head -1
wc -c /tmp/product.html
pgrep -f "next dev" | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pgrep -f "next dev" || echo "stopped"
